inventory.source: fr40-inventory report (lead run state, recovered copy); per-candidate candidates.json was not recovered

design.test: one-sided exact McNemar (sign test on discordant units), unit = fix-commit cluster
design.killInterval: Bonett-Price adjusted Wald 90% interval for paired proportions

scenarios.name: optimistic ceiling, every needs-check task usable and independent

reachability.go: unreachable in practice: at 5 clusters GO needs all 5 clusters discordant for B and has power at most 0.002; even the optimistic 28 independent tasks reach at most 0.314
reachability.kill: unreachable in practice: a null B arm fires KILL with probability at most 0.018 at 5 clusters and at most 0.396 at 28 tasks

action: Do not build FR-40.
